purpose: Harder, independently written validation commands for the router (v1 validation saturated at 100 %, so it could not select a training length). Used ONLY to choose one shared training length for all levels and the abstention threshold; never for training. Disjoint from instructions_v1 and from the Results 8.4 benchmark (near-duplicates removed automatically).
